Netflix to Premiere First Pakistani Series in December

Netflix will premiere its first Pakistani series, titled ‘Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo’, in December. The series is set to debut on December 4 and will feature a reunion of actors Fawad Khan and Mahira Khan.
